reason: I choose my own vegetables, fruit and meat, and I am not letting a stranger pick them for me. I already drive to Jbeil on Saturday for the big shop, so I do not need this.
objection: Someone else picking my tomatoes and meat, and I have to pay a $2 fee on top for it. I can't check anything until I'm at the pickup point and the money is already spent.
would_change_my_mind: If I could look at the produce and meat at pickup and refuse anything I don't like without paying, I might try it for dry goods and cartons.
